content.text: {"summary":"To substitute 1.5*u for u, I multiplied the u-input column of W1 (column 2) by 1.5 in all 12 rows. Each hidden unit's pre-activation then sees exactly 1.5*u, so f_new(q,v,u)=f_old(q,v,1.5*u) holds exactly everywhere. No other weights change. The damping estimate is rough: it is the slope df/dv at the origin, about 0.72 from the units active there.
